title: HC8406 guiding reports successful completion after a failed stop
summary: Category functional; severity medium; confidence high. Owner coordinator; open, nonblocking audit follow-up. Location: indigo_drivers/mount_ioptron/indigo_mount_ioptron.driver:2264-2279. For HC8406, both guide finalizers call ioptron_no_reply_command(:Qn#/:Qe#) and discard its boolean result, zero pulse values and publish unconditional OK. The pulse start path:1087-1115 uses indefinite directional commands for this protocol rather than device-timed pulses, so the final stop is the event that ends physical guiding. A failed transport stop leaves movement unconfirmed while reporting success. The helper:212 already returns a failure signal; use it to publish ALERT and retain/recover uncertain motion status. Disconnect/abort should not erase a failed-stop state without reconciliation. Compare other mount finalizers (lx2004498 etc.) that already use their stop result. Existing GPIO finalizer finding ...repository-audit-011 is a separate driver/sink. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (FM-4). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
